development_cases_excluded.NGC2541: used to develop and audit the side-consistency statistic, footprint rule, centre nuisance set, beam rule, and solver diagnostics
development_cases_excluded.NGC3198: prior Paper 8 diagnostic scan and predeclared replay score were already opened
development_cases_excluded.NGC5055: included in the Paper 8 SPARC rotation-curve training population

current_source_pool_audit.consequence: NGC925 was source-only demoted from the clean lane after its independent physical-MC audit exposed inner non-identifiability and its outer-only audit exposed known disturbed-gas terminal contamination. NGC4062 is next. HALOGAS alone cannot populate the frozen N>=12 confirmatory cohort; at least four eligible galaxies must come from an independent survey family unless the design is preregisteredly revised before endpoint access

eligibility: source-published signed radial morphology descriptor includes radius, inclination, position angle, uncertainties, and approaching/receding or spin convention
descriptor is frozen without access to the confirmatory endpoint summary statistic
endpoint map is independently reduced and its observation provenance is audited against the morphology source
all fixed, morphology, and wrong-family geometries use the identical finite sky-pixel intersection
each accepted side-ring cell contains at least two synthesized-beam areas after masking
beam-scale spatial blocks or an equivalent source-frozen covariance model replace pixel-iid and ring-iid inference
source-published astrometric and kinematic centres and their uncertainty envelope are evaluated as frozen nuisances
inclination and position-angle uncertainty, including covariance when published, is propagated
the coordinate solve satisfies a source-frozen convergence tolerance; iteration count alone is insufficient
moment-1 limitations, warp overlap, and extraplanar-gas contamination are audited or a stronger terminal is used
galaxy_loss: L_g^(a) = sum_r w_g,r e_g,r^(a), with source-frozen covariance-aware normalized weights
source_side_wrong_family_controls: donor morphology profile matched only on preregistered support variables
nuisance_reporting: orientation uncertainty draws or quadrature nodes

confirmatory_statistics.test: exact galaxy-level shared-sign permutation for mean A_g and mean D_g
confirmatory_statistics.multiplicity: max-T adjustment across the two primary gains and the frozen wrong-family family
secondary: fraction of galaxies with A_g > 0 is at least 0.60
fraction of galaxies with D_g > 0 is at least 0.60
leave-one-galaxy-out means remain positive for A_g and D_g

claim_boundary: Passing would be a predeclared population-level morphology/readout calibration signal only. It would not derive or select a physical q_R, prove the parent morphology, establish Nature occupation, or replace dark matter.
